description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Peter was excellent
review: Peter was excellent. On time, efficient, friendly and informative.  Definitely recommend and will have again next year.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Good  job work was carried out professionally…
review: The work was carried out professionally with no mess and I was reassured that the installation was safe

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: The service was excellent
review: The service was excellent. Quick clean and efficient. Experienced service with good personal skills.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Very professional, no mess
review: Very professional, clearly experienced and informed. Understood problems and solutions, communicated high level weather concepts and how they related to the stove clearly and in understandable language. Had all his own equipment, left no mess

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Exceptional
review: Gareth was exceptional. He was personable and took so much pride in a job well done. A rare quality in modern tradespeople, we would give him six stars if we could also a great ambassador for his company, highly recommended and would certainly use him again.Mike & Ann WebsterChandlers Ford

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Good for another year.
review: Always a pleasure to hang around while Matthew is doing his sweeping. He is always happy to install or repair parts and has good advice and knowledge of how to get a clean burn and avoid tarring up your flue.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Quick, professional, tidy and affordable!
review: Quick, professional, friendly and affordable! You can't really ask for much more than that. Absolutely zero mess and a fantastic job done by Ian McMullen.This is the second time we've used their services and we'll definitely be a repeat customer!

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Stress free experience.
review: The chimney was swept by a very pleasant man, who took great pains to keep any mess and disruption to an absolute minimum, he even wore boot protectors coming in and out of the house. He was polite, quick, considerate and happy to answer no end of questions. The whole job was done in a very short time and apart from a faint wiff of soot, you'd never have known he'd been there. Also i rang him at 8am for an ETA and he then arrived that afternoon exactly when he said he would. I then recieved my certifcate with my invoice that i was able to pay  by BACs. Perfect.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Attention to detail
review: Arriving on time. Being completely honest about the bend in the chimney which made sweeping the hall chimney almost impossible. Going the extra mile to empty the grate when I had failed to do so.  Leaving everything spotless.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Our cleaner Gareth was polite
review: Our cleaner Gareth was polite, friendly and professional, he was on time, and the work was done efficiently and cleanly! Perfect service. Thankyou

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Clean and efficient but an hour later…
review: Clean and efficient but an hour later than booked

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: John did a great and tidy job
review: John did a great and tidy job. Would be five stars except he arrived much earlier than expected, which caused some issues for us due to managing in-progress remote working meetings. A few years ago this would not have caused a problem. But since the introduction of hybrid working patterns scheduling  work on your house has become more difficult for both sides.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: As always,prompt,neatandfriendly
review: As always,prompt,neatandfriendly. we have an eco-stove which is more tricky than many, so despite having the maker's guide,the cleaning wasnot immediatelysuccessful. However, a requested second visit was made very quickly and cheerfullywhich resulted in the stove then burning perfectly, so many thanks for that. So really this merits five  stars.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Great job!
review: Leigh arrived within the allocated time and swept our two chimneys as requested. He was a meticulous worker and tidied up carefully after each sweep. He did a great job whilst answering a few questions I had too. A very interesting man to talk to. Thanks for doing a good job and see you next year!

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Highly Recommended Chimney Sweep
review: I have used this company for many years and I have always been satisfied with service provided. There is no mess & my home was treated with respect & care. Adam turned up when promised. Wilkins  have my complete trust & confidence I was somewhat  disappointed that they are now unable to do a Saturday booking which means I have had to take a day off work which is why I have given a 4 star rating rather than my usual 5.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Good
review: More expensive than our previous chimney sweep, but they did a thorough job and cleaned up afterwards. They did arrive nearly an hour late but my husband was working from home so no big issue. Might be a problem for others though?

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: From call to clean was quick and tidy
review: from call to clean was quick and tidy. John offered further advice on another fireplace too which was appreciated. I'd also appreciated it if he'd brought me some wood.. at least tried to sell me some during the booking or even as he was leaving.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: After the first visit we experienced soot falls
review: After the first visit we experienced some soot falling from the chimney. I questioned if this was normal with the office they said it was possible that some soot had not been cleaned of the ‘ledge’ but agreed a second cleaning cleaning with no charge and no fuss. Since the second cleaning we have had no more soot falls. All in all a professional and efficient service.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Disappointed that the young man didn’t…
review: Disappointed that the young man didn’t wear any protective covering over his shoes so came in from a wet lane and straight onto our carpet. Other than that very pleasant and chatty.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: The chimney sweeper was prompt and…
review: The chimney sweeper was prompt and polite and explained everything well. My only query afterwards would be why the fire place wasn't covered more whilst he was sweeping to reduce the dust and smell as had been the case with a previous sweeper.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Just to say
review: Just to say , although my chimney liner is at fault the service was very professional & options pointed out to me . Did miss the fact I had CO monitor on stairs but all in all pleased with service .

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Service good and efficient
review: Service good and efficient. Only slight problem is we booked for two chimneys to be swept and the sweep only swept one, as apparently he had condemned the one above the wood burner on a previous visit. (we only recently bought the house) and we still had to pay for the double slot. So be aware.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Good, but...
review: Service was swift, efficient and friendly but strangely, the report said that my CO detector was "Present" and "Working" although it ran out of battery power two years ago. Tut, tut.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Stephen arrived on time and did the…
review: Stephen arrived on time and did the sweep and checks efficiently and also helped replaced a cracked stove brick.I would have liked a hand written certificate on completion of the work but one was forwarded to me by email together with and invoice

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Professional and effective
review: This company are organised, efficient and excellent communicators. From the outset, appointments are made quickly. Everything is confirmed in writing and their website gives good information on the entire process.The staff member who attended was experienced and proficient- albeit he cracked the baffle plate at the rear of the stove. This was accidental and the owner, John, was quick to source a new plate and effect a repair.I found the whole experience professional and well organised. I will use again.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Camera Inspection
review: I have an ongoing problem with smoke ingress, which is proving difficult to resolve.  They explained what they were going to do and were good at answering my questions.   They also responded helpfully via email after their visit

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Friendly, Helpful & Professional
review: Friendly, helpful and professional. I had two chimneys swept and both were done efficiently and to a high standard. Negligible mess and disruption caused.  I would happily recommend Wilkins Chimney Sweep to friends.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: The overall experience was OK but…
review: The overall experience was OK but during the sweep I noticed the operator had forgotten to connect the hose to the vacuum cleaner.  This may have been a momentary lapse or had been unconnected for some minutes.  I would use Wilkins Chimney Sweep again.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Great concept
review: Great concept, but the build quality didn’t meet my expectations

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Clean and efficient service as usual.
review: The service was clean and efficient as usual, but on the certificate the CO monitor was marked as N/A. Philip didn't ask about it and of course I forgot all about it too!! Therefore it was not checked this time.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Fire stove
review: He didn't seem friendly, also never mentioned that one of the fire bricks was broken until we bought it up, never knew how to remove fire bricks until my husband informed him

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Boot prints
review: Work was carried out well but left black boot prints in the wc and on carpets.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: The service was fine and the chap nice…
review: The service was fine and the chap nice but i was disappointed when i found he'd emptied the ash on my front garden.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Hi the initial booking was great no…
review: Hi the initial booking was great no problem.The man came on time and the chimney clean was very efficient no dust or dirt.The man said he would email our certificate. We have not recieved it yet our clean was on the 15th so that's 2 weeks ago.I am sure it will be sent soon he should have informed us that it could take a while.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Could have done better…
review: All the rubbish removed from the chimney was left for me to dispose and not taken away. 2 pigeons where found in the chimney but no recommendations given about installing a cowl over the chimney which I would have liked done as an 'extra'.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: I found that the office staff are not…
review: I found that the office staff are not overly truthful with information. When the chap came to sweep the chimney all fine then decided he wished to show my wife on how to set a fire, a little condescending in my opinion.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Sweep
review: We didn’t have John this time around it was his colleague. Chimney swept with no issues. Gasket had come away slightly so the guy glued it. In my opinion in needs changing but for 2 years running they’ve said it was ok. Don’t seem keen on doing it if I’m honest!

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Would not use again 😕
review: Have experienced many visits from chimney sweeps over the last 15 years .. this certainly wasn't the best one. I have discussed the outcomes of a broken flue on our morso wood burner with Adrian (the boss) the next day whilst on way to get my flue cover repaired. Gareth the chap who swept the chimney mid afternoon said that he'd contact his boss and left. I contacted and left a message asking someone to contact me.Whilst the outcome of the broken back plate on flue could have happened at any time with any sweep .. the communication from sweep on site and time for boss to come back to me was poor. I have suggested that this is a potential learning point and was advised that "many customers didn't like follow up calls at about 8pm" which was the time I was advised by Adrian he  had received feedback at close of play from his team.  If there is a problem and a customer is left without main heating .. I would suggest that ALL the sweeps are instructed to contact boss immediately so that any options can be confirmed in a timely fashion .. there may well be none .. but we had our sweep visit mid afternoon and did feel abandoned which as I discussed with Adrian who surprised me by reporting the frequency of woodburner issues he and his sweeps deal with on a regular basis  .. this may well be the case but we've had our burner 15 years and experienced no problems. So, when we did experience a problem, it would be great for the knowledge with potential options and timescales to be shared at time of sweep taking place. Too late for us, but may be useful should you experience something similar ..

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: I didn’t like the all knowing approach
review: I didn’t like the all knowing approach, put the co sensor here or here attach to wall? No!I didn’t like the comment that it’s been awhile since we had it cleaned, it was only left last year?I didn’t like the tone when told me to remove dog whilst he works?I didn’t like comment after telling him we have problems sometimes lighting the fire due to it blowing back in. He said there you go, lit first time no problem. It was a nice sunny afternoon!!I didn’t like having to leave a deposit and then get a reminder as a regular customer I asked him if all ok outside, the reply was yes alk ok but once managed to get to it? There is lots of access?I found it an unfriendly visit and will have to reconsider using Wilkins next time!

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Arrived promptly
review: Arrived promptlyUnfortunately soot was left on the carpet. I offered to dust sheets which he advised he did not require.???Did not test fire after clean with a smoke test.Otherwise he did a good job and would recommend the company

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Chimney Sweep Experience
review: The actual chimney sweep and the job that he did was excellent. He was considerate, clean in his work, efficient and thorough BUTThe staff carrying out the booking service were not very informative. One hour before our original booking we received a call to tell us that the sweep was ill and we had to reschedule. We had to wait another ten days for another appointment which was very inconvenient, it was to be a different sweep and the charge was £7 more! On the day of the second appointment we were again called to say that the sweep was not coming due to unforeseen circumstances and we would have to reschedule. I was very angry as we were having a wood burner stove fitted the following week and the chimney had to be swept. I asked for a call back in one hour with an explanation and a booking that day. I did not receive a call back and when I called I was informed that the sweep would arrive at 15:00 - 16:00 that same day. At 16:15 the sweep rang and said he was on route. He explained that he had an agreement with the owner that if he was on a night shift the night before that he would start his appointments a little later in the morning. The booking service knew this but did not convey this message to us.I think that the chimney sweep company is being let down by the booking service. It caused me a lot of stress and unnecessary upset just to get our chimney swept.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Your sweep did one chimney…
review: Your sweep did one chimney successfully, but failed to access the second one. No other sweep has had this problem.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Carl arrived on time and was an polite…
review: Carl arrived on time and was an polite worker, but he was only working on the chimney for  30 to 40 minutes at a cost of £74.00.I forgot to ask the cost of his visit and felt it was quite expensive, as there was a sooty film on the mantle piece and either side of the hearth. The last chimney sweep charged me £50.00.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Too many problems
review: I've had a woodburner for 10 years and had the chimney swept every year. I've never been told before that my "chimney cap shouldn't be on". Never been asked "how am I supposed to reach that?" (there is an access panel about 10 feet up ther side wall) It turned out he had a ladder anyway. Never been asked "how am I supposed to plug my vacuum cleaner in so far away from the socket?" I offered an extension cable but it turned out he had one in his van any way! He arrived an hour early and wasn't happy that I didn't realise he was there to let him in until the booked time.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: I hadn't realised it was a Franchise
review: Rather curt operator who came one and a half hours early and seemed very much in a rush. Left the  2 front  doors open so nearly lost one of my house cats  He did however, seem efficient and left no mess

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Close the gates as you find them
review: Hi the sweep arrived in the time specified and the job was carried out fine bit sweep left the property he left all the gates open and my dogs got out and took themselves for a walk not happy about it the sweep opened the gates to bring his van on to the drive then just drove off with out shutting them

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Reasonably good job
review: Reasonably good job, but very expensive for approx 20mins work.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: I did not totally trust the guy who…
review: I did not totally trust the guy who came to do the work even he had been before.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Price had gone up 20% since booking…
review: Price had gone up 20% since booking with no notification, and when asked for feedback following the sweep, none was given verbally and it wasn’t until I received certificate stating a recommendation of a power sweep - no idea what that is!? Last year was Heatas certified and this year it wasn’t. No issue with actual work - was clean tidy, punctual and polite.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Very expensive
review: Very expensive. The whole job took 15 minutes and cost £75 or £300 pounds an hour

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Disappointing
review: Chimney sweep from Andy Neville at Wilkins Chimney Sweep arrived on time and was polite, knowledgeable and didn't leave even a speck of soot.  Was delighted at this stage and was hoping to use Wilkins regularly in the future.  Was also looking forward to having an open fire.  The sweep recommended a different chimney cowl and said he would ask Andy to organise a quote.  Six weeks later, four emails and three telephone calls later I still have no quote.   Really disappointing.  Wish I'd gone elsewhere.  Thought it was going to be easy dealing with a large company but on closer inspection it's actually a franchise under which the members may do as they wish.  Perhaps I was just unlucky but I would not recommend Wilkins Chimney Sweep given my experience.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: stop moaning to the customer that your…
review: stop moaning to the customer that your too busy and had too many appointments booked.  Not our problem and what a nice problem to have part way through a recession?

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Not great.
review: Your Sweep wasn’t particularly sociable. He did a good job I suppose but then I had a lot of hassle getting the Certificatr required as part of my tenancy agreement. My name is Sarah. I’m Mrs. You seemed to think I was James. Nobody called James lives at my address. I booked you. I paid you. I know nobody called James. I won’t use your company again thank you. Not impressed.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Arrived on time and covered area to…
review: Arrived on time and covered area to protect room from soot. The whole process took 30 minutes including setting up time and clearing away.  We didn't feel enough time was spent on sweeping the chimney as soot could still be seen. My partner finished removing more soot the next day. Quite a bit fell down quite easily. He commented that the brush looked old and worn out. This could explain why soot was left behind.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Man did good job
review: Man did good job . After a while after leaving he phoned to say he found dads poker in his bag I told him tongs were missing too . He said he hadn’t found tongs . He returned poker later that day . Had to go out and buy another pair of tongs unfortunately could only find a shorter pair

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: There was nothing put down when he…
review: There was nothing put down when he emptied the chimney outside.   He undone it and the Soot just fell out all over the patio and the wall.   He hoovered it but was left in a state for me clean up after he left.  Wasn’t happy to be honest

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Disappointed customer
review: My log stove and flue liner was installed 2 years ago at a cost of £1000 for installation only.  The installation was performed by HEATAS engineers.  This is the first time the flue has been swept - the log stove is used infrequently.  During the sweeping process the flue became dislodged from the stove.  Have contacted original installers who state repair will possibly have to wait until 2021 at an estimated cost of £100.  Cannot use this log stove until fixed. Am very disappointed with this experience

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: One bolt had rounded so they refused to…
review: One bolt had rounded so they refused to do any further work and sweep the chimney. I was able to fix this myself with a simple tool in 5 mins afterwards. I would have expected this from the service.Still got charged though.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Good service and very efficient but…
review: Good service and very efficient but broke a fire brick and said they are cheap to buy just go to the local shop. Completely not true. Cheapest one ive found is £33 and I'm not sure it's the right one. Now I have no stove until I can find one.

description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep
title: Yr engineer came to
review: Yr engineer came toLook at cracked chimney pot after chimney fire. He said it would need to be replaced but didn’t know anyone who could do it so can’t really comment. There was no charge. John n Geraldine O’sullivan

title: Not as great a deal as you would think.
review: Although the original rep from H2B was extremely informative and honest, the company they forwarded us onto, Sunshine Home Improvements, I felt, was quite unprofessional. After having made an appointment date and time, I was called a further three times to be told they "were in the area" and could come earlier despite being told I would not be at home. They ended up turning up half an hour early as I felt pressured into being home earlier to accommodate them. Although Amy from Sunshine Home Improvements was very nice indeed, I explained at the forefront that I do not agree with "pressurised sales tactics" to which she agreed, but I was still subjected to. I appreciate that this was her job but it was extremely uncomfortable.  I have had several quotes from other companies for around the £9000 which seemed very reasonable and had hoped that Sunshine Home Improvements could better those with the discount they purport to give. Unfortunately their quote was £19,000 for six windows and two doors, £10,000 more than everyone else! They "discounted" it down to £17,000 which I promptly declined. Amy then called her supervisor (textbook sales tactics), who then said he would knock off a further £6000 if I agreed to have them replaced within the next two months in the winter! If I were to replace my windows, it would not matter what time of year it took place. A quote is a quote regardless of what time of year it is! Unfortunately, I feel I have been misled in certain aspects of this scheme and will be purchasing my windows from a more reputable, professional and client orientated local business. Thank you but no thank you.

The phone line was poor, it kept cutting out and there was a lot of background noise at the call centre and I struggled to hear what the lady on the phone was saying.  What I did not fail to hear, though, was her rude and arrogant tone!  If I hadn't needed an urgent repair, because of this lady I would have put the phone down and gone somewhere else!  She sounded as if she was doing me a favour by speaking to me!Anyway, I persevered with the call and an engineer was booked in for the following morning.  He, Sam, arrived within the allotted time frame and could see what the problem was straight away.  Within half an hour my window's hinges were replaced and the house was secure again.  It is people like Sam that make or break a company and he was spot on and a credit to Able.  Quick, tidy and friendly, unlike the lady at the call centre!

Throughout our experience with Moorland we found Brad to be very helpful.

title: Do not recommend- Hard to get appointments. Lazy service.
review: When we first moved into our property part of the terms were that the previous owner would pay for a knotweed eradication programme. So we moved in with a prepaid contract with Japanese Knotweed Ltd worth around 15K. It was to supply treatment to the surrounding gardens (around 4) for 3 years and ourselves for 5.I have to admit I have never found dealings with this company anything but frustrating. I am always made to feel like I they are doing me a favour. When we first started organising appointments JKL wanted me to individually contact all my neighbours and organise a single appointment per year so it was convenient for the technician (and cheaper for JKL). I immediately said no. They had to contact each neighbour individually by phone or email and organise single appointments that were most convenient for each individual household as they had been paid a lot for this service. This put them out a bit and I got calls telling me private details about my neighbours regarding value of equipment in their sheds etc. This shocked me as it was unprofessional and in violation of privacy laws.It has now been 3 years and the service has only got worse. I always have to call at the begging of summer to organise visits. Appointments are few a far between so hard to get. They will ONLY come if they are in your immediate area. They will not do evenings or weekends so you have to take time off work for a 5 minute spray. They do not chase up for feedback or to rearrange appointments. I have noticed that a lot of the positive reviews are from people that simply sent in pictures to check if the plant in fact knotweed. It seems that JKL are very good at giving good initial service to gain contracts but once they have been paid the service is very lazy. I would recommend looking at other options or at least not paying upfront.

title: I have no problem with the actual …
review: I have no problem with the actual service I have received, or with the front line staff of this company. However I feel this company takes advantage of a difficult legal situation for homeowners.  I  discovered  a tiny patch of Japanese  knotweed on our property, a long way from the house, which I could easily deal with myself, but when I tried to buy some herbicide at a local garden centre I found out there is a completely over the top legal requirement for only specialist companies to deal with this, and dispose of the waste, Japanese Knotweed becomes a problem if you ever want to sell your house, which you must declare, so homeowners are forced to engage these sorts of companies to get rid of Japanese Knotweed  at huge expense. They seem to charge the same to get rid of one tiny plant as they do for a major infestation, which I think is unfair. I think this is an unbelievably overpriced service for so little in return. One visit, to investigate, and one visit to spray a herbicide on a very tiny plant with a few leaves, which kills the plant in the first visit,  nothing else needs to be done, and we are still going to have to pay a huge sum of money for years of unnecessary visits and a guarantee to be Knotweed free, which we have to have,  ,which seems very poor value for money.

review: Some of the staff at this company need more training. I was communicating with Tom O'Connell to book a survey and I wanted some of my concerns answered. He gave extremely vague responses to my questions, which was really disappointing. I emailed him again to get a more clearer answer but he gave me the same vague responses. I then phoned him but it seemed he still didn’t understand the question. I simply wanted to know that in the event the vendors try to hide the presence of Japanese knotweed at the property for example by cutting it, can the surveyors still determine if there are any signs of concealment (I know the surveys are visual investigations hence why I said will they look for signs of concealment). He still didn’t understand me. I spoke to my business partner and he agreed that we needed a clearer answer in order to go ahead with the survey. I emailed him again, wording the question slightly different but he gave the same vague answer he gave the day before. When I asked him that if he didn’t understand the question could he ask one of his colleagues and tell them to get back to me, he told me to contact him. I mean we spoke yesterday and you didn’t know the answer then so what is the point of calling you again???? I was extremely frustrated with this encounter. I contacted another company and they were able to explain my queries in depth. They explained that the even though the survey is a visual inspection the surveyors will look for signs of concealment such as barrier membrane present on site, dead canes placed in garden areas, leaf bleaching. This gave me the confidence that this company knows what they are doing. So we are now using them to carry out a survey at our property. We are a buy to let company and if Tom was able to answer the questions provided to him properly, then we would have used this company not only for our current property but for future properties as well. I still don’t understand why Tom couldn’t have just asked someone if he was unsure. It’s extremely unprofessional from Tom. In terms of constructive feedback the company needs to give him further training on how to deal with queries he is not sure about. I also recommend the company train him in how to write emails properly and professionally as it felt like a teenager was responding to the emails. This gave me the perception that he doesn’t have the appropriate skills needed to carry out his role. I recommend customers who are thinking of using this company to think again and use other companies who are willing to give clearer answers.

He didn’t push us to make a decision on the spot, which we really appreciated. Shortly after, Adam from Huntingdon gave us a call and arranged for Gertruda to visit us that evening. She also recognised that our home’s location could provide good footfall exposure for the business, which helped us secure a great deal.The team prioritised our installation due to the poor state of our door, and within four weeks, Matt and Andy arrived at 7:30am sharp to carry out the work. They were polite, efficient, and left the area tidy. After the installation, they took the time to explain everything clearly. My partner, who is a builder, later inspected the work and found a few minor adjustments were needed for a perfect fit. The company responded quickly, sending someone out the following week to assess and address the issues. By the next day, the door had been fully adjusted, and everything was perfect.We did discover a small crack in the corner of one glass panel, but the team reassured us it will be replaced in the new year. Their communication and willingness to resolve issues have been excellent throughout.We’ve been so impressed that we’ve already arranged for three additional windows at the back of the house to be replaced. Once again, Gertruda has gone above and beyond, explaining payment options clearly and even surprising us with a box of chocolates and a thoughtful Merry Christmas wish.We are thoroughly looking forward to working with this company again in 2025 and cannot recommend them highly enough! The team’s professionalism, customer care, and dedication to getting everything right have been second to none.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

review: I have given three stars as unfortunately we were given five separate installation dates and these kept getting cancelled at the last minute to the point where we never thought we’d get our windows. Sixth time round however we FINALLY had our bay window and back door fitted by two lovely lads Craig and Daniel. I can not praise them highly enough. They were on time, efficient, tidy and very polite informing me of the process they needed to do and they were even concerned about if I had somewhere warm to go and wait whilst they fitted everything. Very conscientious even ensuring our puppy did not get out of the back gate. Craig and Daniel are an asset to your team and if I have any windows needed in future I hope they are the fitters that come back. Five stars for the fitting team of Craig Lambert and Daniel Gooch!!

The lounge ones have been refitted successfully but the bedroom blinds can not be refitted as there is a gap of 25mm all the way round each blind . I phoned your company about this problem and was assured Byron would telephone me. This has not happened which is a poor reflection on your business. I have contacted the blinds company who have quoted me £350 for infill beading. All this should have been taken into account by the surveyor

review: The windows and doors are very good quality, made a huge difference to retaining the heating in the house. Installers were polite and very clean, very impressed.I put 3 stars because of communication problem, seems like a company-wide issue. - Scaffolding arrived a day earlier (did not let us know)- installers told me "on monday someone will come to inspect" (as we had a scratch/chip on the front door - still waiting for a replacement.) They did not turn up.- Email received from installation manager advising they do not always come out. (making it out that i am bothersome to them)- Scaffolding are still up two weeks after installation, no one informed us it will be there that long and no date of dismantling.- no date or timescale for the replacements.I am not sure if I will use them again.

title: Shocking Service
review: Despite being assured by the sales rep that everything would be left in order in completion of the works to our four former windows, a supposedly two day job ended up taking nearly two weeks to resolve and then only because we undertook some work ourselves. Once the work the FHI had been employed to do was done we were left with damaged rendering, roof tiles and missing sealant.We had to continually chase up various managers to get a resolution. Invariably promised phone calls or visits were not made and there appears to be no continuity or joined up thinking between the various trades. ( Why not send out a team fully equipped to resolve all possible eventualities in the first place?)We will never employ to FHI to do work for us again and would advise others to do the same. Shocking service for a supposedly professional firm.

title: Really disappointing all round
review: Really disappointing all round. We were sold the dream by the sales person and were totally let down. The apprentice managed to drop one of our 4 windows on the installation date and it took nearly 6 weeks for the replacement to be delivered. The installers left our home in a mess on their first visit and lost a part of our blinds when taking them down so had to replace, this all despite us being told by the sales person that they’d clean the windows and leave everything immaculate.Then to add insult to injury, our newly plastered cornicing in our lounge cracked during the final window install and the company would not accept any liability for this despite it clearly being from the window above being replaced. This company was not cheap and we went with them because we were promised a first class service which we absolutely didn’t get. I certainly won’t be recommending.

At the other end I had asked the guys to connect my washing machine at my own risk and the chap looked and told me he couldn't as it needed isolators. I then had to buy these and find a plumber  pretty quickly - when he came he didn't need the isolators and just connected the pipes so I feel I was misled and this has cost me c£50. Maybe this is all in the small print but as I said I had expected a similar if not better service from this company based on all the reviews that I had read but in reality it gave me more challenges than I needed at a stressful time. It wasn't a bad service, just decidedly average.

title: Sloppy Job - Series 1. Episode 2.
review: Following my last 20/11/24 Trustpilot rating Oven Support Ltd have responded and have revisited to assess the clean and the damage to the adjacent kitchen unit doors.The assessor, who was the original cleaner, assessed his own works and apologised several times for the poor standard of cleaning.  He acknowledged that there was damage to the unit doors but suggested that the damage may have been caused by heat from the oven and that I had only noticed it whilst inspecting his work.  This is a ridiculous suggestion as the oven and units have been adjacent for 7 years, why would there be damage just now?I asked the cleaner what spray cleaner he used and he told me that he does not use any corrosive products but he failed to confirm what the actual product was. Whatever the product was it has damaged the high gloss melamine face of the unit doors and discoloured the aluminium control switch and the stainless steel trims.   Should such a product be used in our homes without fair warning and what are the risks to our health?The assessor said I will hear from Oven Support Ltd to discuss a resolution, I have heard nothing, wait for episode 3.

title: Good Product and Installation....Need to address some Administration Aspects
review: I would rate the product and the workmanship of the installation engineers as very high and have no issues whatsoever with this aspect of the company. However I feel that the organisation let themselves down in two "customer support areas".Firstly in Customer Liaison. The salesperson who initially visited, and prior to scheduling an installation date and time, gave the clear impression that work would be completed by 4.00 pm. The morning installation was changed at the request of the company to the afternoon. The engineers did not arrive until 3.45 pm and although they worked tirelessly there was still quite a lot of work to do by 7.00 pm. Unaware that the job would take so long, I had to ask them to leave since I had another appointment that could not be rescheduled. They did however return the next morning and completed the installation within a couple of hours.I would have thought it appropriate that some forewarning be given regarding the estimated installation time and any late working.Secondly Quality of Operating InstructionsAlthough the engineer explained and demonstrated the system the only instructions left were the product instructions provided by the manufactures of the cameras and recorder. Although I appreciate that each system they install are probably slightly different to each other, I would have thought that a General Instruction sheet could, and should be, compiled by the company has a “memory jogger” covering the common points of a system, particularly given the cost of the system.I would reiterate that the engineer’s explanation and demonstration was thorough but like most of these things when at a future date you need to clarify or reset something this often when the details have been forgotten. I therefore believe that a General Instruction Sheet(s) would constitute a significant improvement to this particular area.

title: Poor sales experience
review: I have had quite a journey with eyesec and non too favourable.I am aware of the impact customers reviews can have on companies so I will be fair and factual but I must voice my concerns on how I feel I was misled with the quotes received and whilst this was packaged up as a fantastic deal, it was no such thing.I agreed earlier this year for the company to send a sales rep to demo their product and provide me with a quote.  I appreciate that they have a job to do and there was going to be a lot of sales tactics going on.  After two hours the rep had gone through her pitch and provided me with a quote.  A very high quote which, I decided not to sign up to despite her trying to close the deal on the day.Fast forward 4 months later.  Eyesec contacted me to ask if I could give them some feedback on my appointment and the quote received.  I informed them of the very long meeting and the price which I concluded was far too high for me and did not want to purchase the product.  They agreed and also agreed the quote seemed high, they asked if they could send a manager to come and see me as they could give a much better price.  I reluctantly and maybe somewhat naively agreed and was promised the appointment would only be about 20 minutes.An hour and a half later and after a lot of hard sell and an offer of a significant discount which would come out of their marketing budget so they could make the deal work for me, I couldn't believe that they actually quoted me a higher price than earlier in the year.  When I challenged them about it and showed them the paperwork, the situation became uncomfortable and the manager proceeded to tell me that the original rep must have quoted me wrong in the first place..So much for them coming out again to give me the deal of the century, had I not had the paperwork (which I had to ask for as she did not offer to leave it) then I could have been out of pocket quite significantly.To conclude, I was absolutely aware there would be a sales pitch, I take responsibility for agreeing to a second visit but I was disappointed that they seemed to be taking me for a ride with the price and it seemed almost unbelievable that they did not do their homework and check what I'd been quoted before despite the fact that following every visit the rep has to call the deal in at the end of the appointment.  Will not trust this company again unfortunately.

title: Fabulous service
review: I don't normally write reviews, but had to make an exception here. Moving house is super stressful, but the Finest Van team made it so much easier!!!  From first contact via the online form, to Ana in the office patiently answering my questions on van size to the absolute fabulous crew of Nuno, Dingo, Rafael and Fabio on Christmas Eve, everything went perfectly. I had packed through the night, and was dreading the doorbell announcing the removal vans, but I shouldn't have worried, I had the most cheerful, polite, careful, efficient and hard-working crew. The crew loaded up my furniture and tons of books into the vans speedily and with a smile, and even helped me to get some shelves off the wall which I couldn't get removed in time for their arrival. Everything arrived in perfect condition and was unloaded with the same care, speed, efficiency and cheerfulness in the new place, despite tricky staircases and tight corners. I am still in awe of the crew, and am wholeheartedly recommending Finest Van to anyone looking to take the stress out of their move day. I was skeptical when I read the glowing reviews online, but this is indeed the Finest Van one can find for moving in London, and if I could give 10 stars I would without hesitation. Guys, you were truly exceptional, thank you so much for making this dreadful day so much better!!!

title: Terrible experience at first, but the company leadership have gone to great lengths to correct this.
review: Update:I have revised my review from 1 star to 3 stars in light of how their leadership team responded and followed up on the situation - Brendan and his team have done a stellar job and it is obvious that they have great passion for not only their brand but also their customers. My bad experience is clearly an anomaly and one they have gone to great lengths to correct which is encouraging to see.To summarize what happened:I used to work in the industry (junk removal) so know all too well how to calculate volume, estimate labor required, etc. However, sadly when asked Just Clear for a quote to remove 4 cubic yards of garden (green) waste from my front yard, the representative from their bookings team (Beth) attempted to overcharge me, first in terms of volume and then by wanting to add additional labour when I called her out on overestimating the volume (I gave the specific amount and she wanted to charge for a lot more...).I queried this with her, explaining that I really do have no more than 4 cubic yards worth of green waste to clear and it is conveniently located in my front drive, meaning the van reverses in & throws it in the back (10 - 15 minutes worth of labor max so no justifiable need for the extra labour), but sadly she did not respond well to having her estimates challenged and insisted "those are our prices" with a take it or leave it attitude / reaction and this cost the company my business (insignificant as that particular bit of business may be). To back up my point, one of their competitors (Clearabee) did the job for significantly less.That being said, the follow up by Brendan and his leadership team has been stellar and as a result my view has changed from "will never use them" to "willing to ask for a quote next time I need something cleared".Perhaps some training needed for the staff in the bookings team - when a client specifies not only the type of waste, but also the actual volume of it to be removed, there's no justification for giving a quote which completely ignores this information...

title: Clearance Cowboys!!!
review: I went ahead with Just Clear on a recommendation from an estate agent. They were expensive compared to all the other quotes I’d obtained but I thought it looked professional and they presented an eco-friendly image. The team of two arrived and was very polite and professional, I had a garage to be cleared as I was moving home. Whilst 70% of the job was done I overheard the driver on the phone to the boss being told that the van (diesel by the way- not sure how this is eco-friendly!) had to be returned back immediately. The driver was apologetic but he had no choice but to leave me hanging. Although he left a member of staff to help, I was left having to hire another van to step in on short notice to clean up the mess Just Clear had put me in. On top of that they kept pushing me to pay. I phoned the company and left a message to discuss payment and the job but no one got back to me. I was then emailed to pay an extra amount (£72 more than what was originally agreed), I made the bank transfer and hope never to deal with this company again. Absolute scam artists. Avoid like the plague!!

title: Polite, prompt, professional
review: Bryan Kelly was right on time, considerate and honest in his assessment as there were some difficult to access areas at the rear of the house. However, he was able to carry out the work conscientiously with minimum fuss. He was polite in his interactions with us and the work was done efficiently.Thanks, Bryan

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Sam Hawkins from Bens Gutters was very…
review: Sam Hawkins from Bens Gutters was very polite and efficient today when cleaning our gutters, understood the problems we have and sorted it all out. Hope to see him next year.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Langdale Road
review: Ben's Gutters man came a little earlier than expected and cleared the guttters around our semi-detached house with his special equipment. The job was completed quite quickly. He checked the result on the video screen attached to his machine. He appeared to be satisfied with the result and it is the case that in spite of heavy rain since the work was done the gutters no longer overflow.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Professional team
review: Everyone on the phone was polite and helpful. There were a couple of dates changed but I was kept informed. Marcin who came was very efficient and neat and tidy. He showed me all the gutters via the camera and he found a little plastic pot that was blocking the gutter. On time, polite and informative, really happy.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: After a cancellation due to bad weather…
review: After a cancellation due to bad weather I was quickly given another appointment. Kevin Rowe turned up promptly and was very courteous. He did a great job on checking and cleaning, and gave feedback on what he had done. Very pleased with the service provided

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Gutter Repair and Clean.
review: The leak from a gutter joint is now sorted and the gutters, facias and soffits were all cleaned. I have a window cleaner who uses a similar telescopic brush system and he brings his own water supply in his van. My water is metered and the operative from Ben's required use of my water supply so bear in mind that cost is over and above. Pleased with the result of the clean and repair though.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Operative Sam was great, but booking system not so much
review: Had it been for Sam alone, who came round today, it would have been 5/5. He was great - professional, courteous and friendly and did a very thorough job. I was really pleased with the service he provided. However, my dealings with the office to set up an appointment in the first place left a lot to be desired as two appointments were cancelled at the last minute and new dates given without consulting me, despite me saying at the outset that I had limited availability and needed to agree a date beforehand.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Feedback
review: See many bad reviews and queries on Price - so take time to place the order and ensure all details are fully supplied - like taking the waste away. Seem to be Edinburgh based. Cannot complain SAM from Whitehills did a good job and was very polite and accommodating. Normally do all the gutters myself house, garage , cabin, so job done 8out of 10 compared to myself, as I normally wash the gutters all out, Have gutter caps/gaurds on all down pipes which are tied to the gutter bracket. Would use them again subject of ensuring pre-agreed price.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: John did a great job
review: John did a great job. There was efficient communication on booking and clear explanation of the work that was done on the day. Today, after John cleaned them, the gutters i can see look much healthier than they did yesterday!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Fair
review: The guy was pleasant & completed all the work requested.  Had a small leak on one of the corners but this was fixed.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Great job
review: Would have been 5 stars except that our original appointment was cancelled, then rearranged and on another occasion nobody arrived. However, when they did arrive they did a brilliant job. Alex was personable, polite, explained what he was doing and worked swiftly and efficiently. Certainly the best option for our tall house!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: The process needs some work!
review: It's the 2nd time using, the 1st time I wasn't there but I was here for the 2nd time, I think the guy who turned up did a reasonable job although missed our highest gutters and hidden ones, All the rubbish from the gutter was left on our flat roof so I am having to clean that up myself and the call center keeps ringing me every day chasing for payment even though I have confirmed payment each time

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Gutters not cleaned properly initially, resolved on further visit.
review: Booking was fine, gutter cleaner turned up spent around an hour.  I checked the gutters after and it looked like they'd hardly done any work. Contacted them by phone and was told I'd get a call back but haven't received anything. Update - resolved few days later, cleaner came back and covered missed sections.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: quick and reliable
review: i recently contacted bens gutters on a friday and they were scheduled to come out on the following Monday being the last call of the day.. unfortunately due to unforeseen circumstances on their part,  they could not attend due to issues with ladders. They attended the next day early in the morning to carry out the work and Daniel was polite, courteous,quick and cleared the guttering above the conservatory. No mess was made and the job was finished within 20-25 minutes.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: An average at best service
review: An average at best serviceI got Ben's Gutters in to clean my house's gutters. I've read other reviews from them where they've received before and after pics, 5 star quality service. The operative they sent out for me was in and out in less than half an hour. £150 for half an hour's work feels quite expensive. One plus is they did arrive on time.In the future I would probably look for a more reasonably priced company if this how long the work actually takes.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: 5* for cleaner Jason from Newcastle. 1* for everything else.
review: 5* for cleaner Jason from Newcastle. 1* for everything else, so met in the middle. We have had a, mixed, experience with Ben's Gutters.Our first appointment was cancelled last minute. At our rescheduled appointment, the cleaner showed up, stayed for 10 minutes max, refused to do one gutter saying it couldn't be done and the others barely cleaned at all bar a mild scrape through the middle of the muck in them. We called back to try and get someone back out, and after another THREE back to back cancelled appointments, and two weeks later, the company sent out Jason, who was absolutely spot on. Stayed for way longer, cleaned every gutter, including the one we were told couldn't be done. Hosed them all through and kept us informed of exactly what he was doing throughout the entire process. Annoying that the rest of the service has let the overall score down, because if we had Jason from the get go, it would have been a 5* review.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: As an older lady
review: As an older lady, alone,I had no means of determining whether the gutters needed cleaning, but thought it proper to do so.One side of my gutters was completely clean ..so paying up front cost me a lot of money for nothing. Had the property been seen for a quote, surely it would have been cheaper. Regarding the service  and punctuality, no complaints

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Payment requesting method made me uncomfortable
review: Service was great and the young man who completed was very polite. The payment method was strange and didn’t feel secure. Phoned and texted by different numbers asking for payments. In the world of scams I will never pay for a service from an unknown number or text message. When I phoned the number off the website I was cut off 3 times. Need to review payment method. Wouldn’t recommend due to this.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Happy overall with service
review: Happy overall with service. Gutters cleaned and disposed of in our green garden waste bin, very respectful worker. Be aware of the quotes, make sure you get everything documented and included in the quote.  I have nearly been charged and extra £50 to take down and replace bird spikes which was clearly documented and included  in the original quote.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: rebalancing be wary review last week
review: I wrote a review last week entitled be wary, I would like to put the record straight to a degree. As another review highlighted communication can be an issue. I would say they did come as originally agreed, they seem to do a professional job. On balance would I use them again, yes

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: I’ve used this company in the past
review: I’ve used this company in the past. Are these reviews on TrustPilot based on individual franchises under the Bens Gutter brand? If so, I think it’s not clear to people looking for a service to base experience on global reviews rather than local teams!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Disappointed
review: Appear to be a very professional outfit with sign-written vans; automated email and text responses and invoicing and an 0800 number. The guys answering the phone were pleasant and friendly.What I am disappointed with though is that the lack of movement on the price.I was quoted £135 (which I of course have paid) for "what could be 2hrs work", they said. The chap came and went within half an hour.I rang, hoping they could do something for me due to the short duration, perhaps 10% off on this occasion but no.It's a shame and in my opinion, a short-sighted way to run a business.For the sake of what, £10-£15, they would have left a happy customer, ready to return next time. Instead, I am disappointed in the lack of flexibility and will definitely not be returning, nor recommending. Too expensive for what it is.A shame.Update:Following this review I have now been contacted by Ben's Gutters and have been offered a £25 refund. This, I am grateful for. Thank you.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Ben's Gutters will clean your gutters
review: Ben's Gutters will clean your gutters, but they told me (looking at my roof from Google Earth) they could fix my two leaks, and they only fixed one - they couldn't reach the other. They can supply a person with a long ladder, so are OK if that's all you need.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Gutters and washing
review: The organisers were rubbish but Ty who did the work was excellent. I would recommend them even though they mucked up times and you can always get through to them on the telephone to speak to.and they are very polite. Once again I can only praise Ty for such good work.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: I hired them based on TP reviews
review: I hired them based on TP reviews. They were to clean the gutters and clean the conservatory roof. Gutters were done ok but as a manual job it was difficult to tell how much had been removed. Would have preferred them to wash the gutters out afterwards. Anyway OKThe equipment they used on the conservatory roof was very low tech. A brush (only one size used)with a supply of cold water. They said they were not allowed to use chemicals. Wasn’t suggesting anything other than a little detergent to help remove the grime. Consequently the conservatory roof looks very similar to its prewashed condition. The guys tried hard but the equipment wasn’t up to the job. The company were not Impressed when I complained and took £27 off the bill even though I sent pictures of the work. Felt it should have been moreIn summary. Gutters ok. If you have a conservatory roof that needs more than a “wash” I would clarify your expectations more than I did in order to avoid my experience

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: OK at best, and disorganised. I'll try someone else next time.
review: I would love to be able to give as good a review as some of the others on here. Got a hand written note through the door, saying they are in the area doing gutters. Checked the reviews and the seemed great. Called them up and the sales agent really up sold how great the service would be. It was OK at best, and that was after 2 visits. Didn't clean the gutters fully, and then said that was what was booked. Didn't clean the conservatory roof and had to come out again to do that, and despite having a 2nd opportunity to step up the gutter cleaning they left the job at that.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Extra payment rip off
review: Arrived on time. Cleared the gutters with extended pole. Didn't appear to check down pipes or swan necks. No big deal as I don't think there is a problem with them. Payed the bill online. Now asking for an extra £25 for sealing leaking joint.This consisted of a small smear of sealant at the sides of one bracket. Approx 2 minutes work and a minimal amount of sealant from a nearly empty tube £25!!!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Don't ask for feedback after they do a…
review: Don't ask for feedback after they do a job for you because they just do not reply. I have emailed 3 times to both their operations and customer service email and nothing! I don't even know if the work was completed.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Not impressed
review: Not impressed. First guy was rude and could manage a grunt at me.  Wasn’t happy lots of dirty areas. 2nd guy came back cleaned better and explained other areas that had some sort of acid issue off the rain. Total rip off. Get your local guys to do it. Will never use these guys again

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Unfortunately job was not completed on…
review: Unfortunately job was not completed on the agreed date and there was no communication from the company.  I had to call them, to be told that there had been problems at a previous job, meaning I would not be attended to.  Gross inconvenience to myself and neighbour.  The company assured me that I would be contacted the following day to provide a two-hour time slot.  This call never materialised.  They unexpectedly turned up however, on a freezing day, and to no surprise could not complete any work because the guttering was frozen.  Now advised that at some point next week I will be contacted.  Not impressed.  I will update.UPDATE:  Job completed.  No compensation offered in respect of the inconvenience caused and being out of pocket financially by booking time off work  to be there at the time of the initial appointment - that they failed to attend.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Job done to a good standard - but.............
review: Job done to a good standard, but he just dumped all the rubbish at our front gate. Also piece of sunroof damaged which I'll need to get.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: I've used this company many times now. No more.
review: I've used this company many times now. When  first started with them, they spent one hour doing the job and did it well. This time, they spent a maximum of 25 minutes doing the job, and left rubbish from the gutters all over my front window sills and my back porch.  They have definitely gone downhill. They will have to prove to me that they can be trusted. At least they came back to clean up the mess!  But it is obvious that they try get more money for less time. Not worth it any more.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Expensive and not well done
review: Easy to book appointment and the allocated worker turned up on time. He removed the debris by hand, I was not impressed that on some occasions he leaned his ladder on the gutter. I would like to have seen photos of the clean gutters, as other companies have done this in the past. He ran water along the gutters but DID NOT check the downpipes and the the first rainfall after his visit showed one to be blocked and the gutters overflowed. An expensive price for a job half done. I would not recommend this company.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Dissatisfied
review: The guy from Bens gutters arrived one hour earlier than arranged.The whole job took 5 mins and cost £77.I am shocked at how expensive this service was. Surely the time the man was there should reflect on the price charged?Needless to say I won’t be using Bens Gutters again!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Rubbish job
review: Nikolay was polite, nice man. At the price charged I expected a much better clean. Only equipment was ladders and a long brush attached to hose, no way is it possible to get a decent clean with the equipment he had. Conservatory roof looks worse than it did before this suppose CLEAN.Nikolay worked hard but I could never recommend as I have had better job done at half the price, cannot write what my wife said !!Also, I asked for all UPVC to be cleaned when getting quote, at price I definitely expected to get what I asked for, sadly not, now have a mixture of dirty and slightly cleaned upvc. Not good !!

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: The initial contact was great and…
review: The initial contact was great and appointment arranged very quickly,  but alas the wheels well and truly came off when the local boy got involved. So much expectation so much hope ...for now...lost.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Contacted Bens Gutters for two of our…
review: Contacted Bens Gutters for two of our sites. Payment was taken upfront and had to chase for invoices. Only received one to date.Have tried contacting on the phone and no response. Emailed and no response.We found out that one of the down pipes at a block was not cleaned (more like all the debris was put down this pipe when cleaning the gutters) and we had damage from the rain water overflowing. We had to pay again for cleaning of this pipe.  Would not recommend them at all.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Billed me for work not even carried out
review: They wanted payment up front which I refused to pay until the guy turned up. The guy then turned up on time but took one look and said he couldn't do it. It may take more expensive equipment like vacuuming the debris out and the company may quote me. Later I got a bill for the work that wasn't even done! *edit, two ignore emails and then FB messenger I'd sent - the person sorted it as it had been marked as completed! So they cancelled the bill and offered to do the more expensive job but I declined.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: No show
review: Booked job on 11th June, for today (20th June). Yesterday received an email with 2 different times lots within 6 minutes of each other.  Today at 1716  a text message to say they could not do the job today, and someone from the office would be in touch.  Wonderful service... not.Mr A Myerscough Update:  the company rang me this morning after i had respindec to their request  for more informTion ans 2 phone calls to answerphone and offered a new vist next week. I therefore cancelled any future involvement with the company.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: VERY EXPENSIVE
review: Work and organisation all ok but quoted £240 on the basis that 2 men needed because involved ladder work but in the end neither guy helped the other with the ladder work. Job was about half hour on site and accepting some travelling time the job was very very expensive.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.
title: Not as thorough as hoped for.
review: Guy arrived promptly at 8am to sort rear gutters, left promptly at 8.15, personally don't think as thorough a job as I was expecting was done as there is new weed regrowth visible less than 2 weeks after the job. Unaware of the downspout being checked for free flowing as they claim to do as assumed he'd use hosepipe for that which was untouched. Unlikely to use their services again.

description:
About the company:
Fantastic Services Family started its journey back in 2009. It all began with a meeting of two like-minded individuals, company founders Rune Sovndahl and Anton Skarlatov. Rune needed a cleaner and Anton ran a cleaning business. Very quickly they both realised they shared a vision and could deliver cleaning services in a much better way, by working together.
With two laptops, a sofa to sit on and a shared mobile phone, a small operation was born. The aim was to build something simple but deliver the best service possible for both clients and cleaning crews. We call that philosophy 360-degree happiness.
From these humble beginnings, we've now grown into a multi-operational business offering a wide range of services to homeowners and commercial customers alike. We've continued to add more domestic services to enhance our portfolio and due to increased demand, these additional services have grown into their own separate brands.
title: Fantastic end of tenancy clean
review: Fantastic end of tenancy clean! And a very competitive price.My flat was cleaned, through Fantastic Services, by Tidy Home Services Ltd, and they did a fantastic job.Turned up 5min early and with all the necessary equipment. Cleaned everything to a great standard, even cleaning all the mould out from the grout between the shower tiles. Called me 30min before finishing so I could come back and inspect the finished property.Fantastic Services then called me later in the day to ask if any issues and confirm that I was happy with the cleaning.So yes, am happy with the cleaning. Reading the other reviews - perhaps it depends on the cleaners that are sent? But I am very happy with the clean I got, and with the price vs. other providers (included a discount).

title: I got convinced to get the £80 Membership...
review: UPDATE: I have updated the rating from 1 star to 4 stars because their customer service team responded within days to this rating and refunded me the £80 without any argument. Further, the original cleaning job was always good (as mentioned in my original review). I got convinced to get the £80 per annum "membership". I received £30 off from an end of tenancy cleaning. In retrospect they overcharged me slightly even with the discount. However, the cleaning job was good. Fast forward a few months later. I asked for a quote on a move in cleaning, a quote on an oven cleaning, an electrician quote, and a quote on a garden/fance repair job (different time periods). The company was consistently way way above and competitor and when I indicated I would not go with them they immediately offered a 30-50% discount. Even so, they were STILL 10-20% above any other competitive quotes. Fast forward 11 months...they charged me for another £89 as they have an automatic renewal (that they do not tell you about during the phone call where they pressure you to sign up to that annual membership). The renewal apparently is charged our 1 month before the 12 months expiration!! In my view this is borderline to a scam and the membership is utterly worthless. Get them on a job by job basis and do NOT agree to the first price they give you when they call you first. A bit of a Turkish bazaar mentality this company.....

title: Such a disappointment … but with a happy ending
review: I had a window cleaning booked for this morning at 8.30, at 7.30 I received a text informing me that "due to bad weather " the window cleaner wouldn't be coming and I would have to reschedule the appointment.  There was no bad weather, it wasn't raining and hasn't rained all day, in actual fact it was been ver pleasant for December and the sun was actually out. All day I have tried to contact to someone and everytime I've called I receive a text to say someone will call but it is now 16.20 and still not had a call. When I did manage to speak to someone earlier they said they could rebook it for the 27th December, what good is that when I needed the windows done for Christmas. Last weekend I had a handy man book to fix a door, the appointment was for between 12 & 5 by 6 O'clock no one had come despite me receiving a text from the handyman saying he was on his way. When I called the office I had to rebook that appointment too, so I waited in all for nothing then too.This company used to be good and I have recommended them to many people in the past as I have been a customer of theirs for years but I would definitely never recommend them again. title: Hit and miss but generally good
review: I think they are great when it comes to small jobs like cleaning and moving. I've used them a couple times for those services and have 0 complaints, the service has always been great and the staff were very efficient, friendly and professional. I took a risk and used them for a big job, to do the flooring in my hallway, which cost £655, I had to buy the flooring, underlay and trim separately, which was £258 so the service was £913 in total. The floorboards were laid okay but the finish was shocking and I'm unbelievably disappointed with the finished product and refuse to believe the worker is a professional. Without going into too much detail, he nailed and glued loose pieces of wood together for the trim and didn't cut them properly so some are sticking out overhanging the wall. The transition strips, don't cover the metal strip between the rooms. He was an hour late, didn't finish and had to come back another day then was 2 hours late. I had floor spacers from a previous job and he took them up and kept them all. I didn't realise he had stolen them until afterwards. He didn't take the waste with him so 2 weeks later I'm still trying to get rid of the wood.After complaining they gave me a refund of £115 for the service and £46 of for the additional materials that he asked me to buy didn't use. After the refunds, I spent £752 in total but I will need to remove the trim and transition strips and have it corrected.My honest opinion on Fantastic Services would be they are fantastic for small jobs like cleaning or tasks under £100. They are responsive and helpful with complaints and I appreciate they do what they can to make good when things don't go well.However, because their workers are contractors and sole traders, the person who is actually assigned to do your work could be terrible and so to me it isn't worth the risk if you're having to part with a significant amount of money. I wish I hadn't used them for my flooring but I will continue to use them for cleaning and odd jobs.Also, a point to note: If you pay for the yearly membership you get £300 credit. The credit works by deducting £30 from each purchase. So if you have £300 credit and buy a service for £200, you will still pay £170 and it will deduct £30 from your credit. Just FYI if you're planning on signing up.
