title: Be careful when signing up for the membership
review: I was very disappointed by the service I received. I was quoted numerous and varying prices for a one-off removal service that I needed. I was then encouraged to sign up to the year's membership without being told that this "membership" would be annual and recurring. I was shocked to see that Fantastic Services had been taking £89 per year from my account for the past years without me knowing about this. I was never informed about this when I initially booked my one-off service. I am not someone to leave reviews in general but I want to help others not fall into this trap. I would highly recommend not using this service. Update on 29/11. After leaving this review, I was contacted by Fantastic Services and was refunded both of the years of my membership. Sadly, it had to get to this stage of leaving this review for this to take place, but I do appreciate that they took action. I hope in the future that the sales team are very clear with clients on what membership involves (including a roll-on payment) so that others do not end up in the situation that I did.

The re-clean was CANCELLED BY FS 20mins before it was due to happen in the evening, at my inconvenience. FS informed me via messaging rather than a phone call, but did not fully explain the cancellation at short notice. They did not call me to re-book this in. Poor customer service after they make a sale. I was huegly let down. Due to proximity to Xmas and my removals arriving, I had to source a local cleaner who was far cheaper yet did a better job than FS - she was not leaving until I was absolutely happy with the oven, dishwasher and washine machine. It was a week battle with FS customer service to get a partial refund after providing many images, another cleaners invoice and constantly calling and messaging. They are quick to get the sale, but very slow when you have a problem. In terms of the leak, they are sending out the plumber with a caveat that "if the plumber finds the leak is nothing to do with the cleaners, I will get charged". They already made claims my leak was not caused by the cleaners, despite them not being the ones staying in the property to know when the leak appeared! This is not booked in for another week and a half. So the bucket I bought will keep catching the water until then...It couldnt get worse that this! Oh but it did... then just hours after Christmas day I recieved an email from the head of customer services saying I'm going to be "charged for cancelling a service 48hrs before it was due to take place". I had not cancelled nor booked any more services after the horrific experience I have had so far. The plumber is what they are looking to send out in the New Year! I refused to book any more services with FS. It has been an absolute nightmare over what is a most stressful period of moving home a week before Christmas! After back and forth negotiation via messaging for a week, the partial refund I got on Xmas day was going to be the reason I did not write a bad review, but it was an email hours later from their Head of Customer Service claiming I will be charged for cancelling a service I didn't even book, was the last straw for me!! It was Greystar (huge global property developer) who recommended FS through their residents app, if Greystar wants to continue with their high standards, then FS should not be their recommended service company. Well, I will now be writing to Greystar... I am hugely disappointed.

title: A Very Poor Cleaning Service
review: Booked for 1pm and after booking I received a confirmation of my booking with arrival of 1.00-2.30pm. They should mention before you pay that the time you book for is not necessarily the time they will come. It was not a problem for me personally but I imagine it would be for many busy people.The property was empty and had had a deep clean only two weeks previously when the tenants moved out. This was just for a general clean to spruce it up a bit for the new tenants. I had written on my booking that the main focus of the cleaning was the kitchen. I asked the cleaner to wash the glasses and kitchen utensils and wipe out the kitchen cupboards. I had booked for three hours cleaning and after two hours the cleaner called to say she had finished ( I do not have a problem with cleaners finishing early if the do the job quickly). When I went to the property, the glasses had been washed and left to dry in the rack but all the other utensils were still sitting on the worktop untouched, where I had left them for her. Nothing else in the kitchen had been cleaned (worktop, sink, cupboards, microwave, floor, etc.).Other than the two bathrooms, the rest of the property looked untouched. Even the cleaning products I had bought and placed on the coffee table were still in the exact same place.A very disappointing service and I am afraid I could not recommend Fantastic Services at all for their cleaning. There are much better cleaning companies out there.

title: Frustrating communication
review: We moved to a new property last year that needed new windows and doors - some urgently so we split the installation due to needing to look at finances. Our first order consisted of 9 windows. front door & patio doors. 9 Windows all fitted on time as we had been told. Comes to following day when doors are due in, waited in ALL day to have to call to be told that our patio doors are in fact not ready! we were given different excuses as to what the issue was depending who we spoke to. They fitted the front door after some grumbling from us as we had been told it was going to be fitted anyway! We waited 2 whole months for the patio doors - with very limited communication as to timescales, initially saying would be a few days then the next week and on and on it went. They absolutely do not call back when they promise they will which was a theme throughout both installations. If they had been upfront about it we would have been fine but the installers left all their trim and mess as beleived installers were coming the following day - this lay in our driveway for 2 months! Overall we were pleased with product. One handle was scratched and had to be replaced, 1 pane of glass was manufactured incorrectly and was replaced, hinge to front door perpetually came loose but the last guy to come seems to have fettled that so we thought we want our others to look same so we asked that they do the next lot which included sash windows. They don't make the sash windows - they outsource them (according to the fitters). We were not given any confirmation dates for scaffolders and only knew of them coming when awoken by them on our roof. We had specifically instructed Coral NOT to walk on this roof due to the nature of the tiles there. Thy had not brought enough scaffold and had to go away with half of it up. We were then told that our windows were not actually ready so not clear why scaffold was going up. On day of installation one window had wrong colour furniture on it, and they used wrong colour sealant despite asking us which colour and so it had to be re-done. Beading on one sash was protruding and sharp.  When the issues did get rectified we had a guy call to arrange this and even though we agreed date due to our work schedules, he called on the day he originally wanted to do it and was a little pushy about coming that day - with me literally having to say NO ONE is physically HOME! After they finished it was late (after 6) and advised the guy who called the following day we would pay that day or day after due to being at work until quite late. We woke to a snotty email and voicemail about not having paid yet...even though I had said when we would be able to and still on the day we said we would have paid by. We spent 18k with these guys. Communication was poor throughout and wished we had not used them after this. I had also recommended them to a friend after first windows went in - she was advised we would get a free gift for recommending and her having work done but this never materialized, so am sure this was nonsense. No recompense offered for time wasted waiting in, poor communication or little more than a half hearted sorry. They were frustrating to say the least. I guess if you can deal with this they are fine.

title: Out of pocket due to company incompetence - I would not recommend
review: PROS-	The salesperson who came for the initial visit was knowledgeable and not at all pushy which I very much appreciated. -	I was quoted a decent price for x4 large windows, a small window and composite door-	Every time I called the main telephone number, the staff in the office who initially took the calls were friendly, professional and helpful. -	The Installation team who came were great – hardworking, friendly, professional, clean and tidy. The day of installation was a long and hard one for them, however they still left with a smile on their faces.-	There were a few issues with the installation, however this was quickly rectified with a follow up visit within 24 hours of the issues being reported.CONS-	I was advised by the surveyor that I would be given a date of installation by a certain date, but this did not happen and I had to call numerous times over a 2 week period, as the planning team failed to return my calls. When I did finally speak with them, they said they were waiting on information from myself, which was not correct. I also fail to understand why it took them so long to return my call to tell me this.-	My first installation date was cancelled with less than 24 hours notice.-	The second installation date came with further issues – the team were supposed to arrive between 8am – 10am. At 10.20am I called the office asking where the team were – I was advised the teams were running an hour late (I would have appreciated a courtesy call to advise me of this, rather than having to call them to find this out). When one team arrived (2 people) they raised concerns regarding the limited time they now had to complete the work, due to the size of the job. They were sent to a job before mine by management, but was very confused as to why, considering it was stipulated on all paperwork my job required a full day and a team of 4. No work was carried out that day which meant I was now out of pocket from job earnings, as I would have to take a further unplanned unpaid leave day from work to accommodate.-	I was given a new installation date for the following week and the work was carried out. When I raised that I was now out of pocket due to the fault of the company, this was dismissed by both the Installation Manager and Senior Installation Manager. Overall there was some positives as highlighted above. If the installation date was only rescheduled once, along with lack of follow up calls, that would have been somewhat ‘ok’. However, as I am now out of pocket due to company incompetence, along with the dismissal from management to give any compensation for this at all, I would not recommend Coral Windows to others, nor would I use them again.

title: Yet another money hungry company that doesn’t pay workers fairly
review: Unfortunately, Maid2Clean don’t pay their workers well at all. This is clear by the fact that they’re average hourly wage for their workers is set at £14. Meanwhile their booking fee is £50. First, cleaning is a hard job - anyone who does their own regular weekend cleaning knows that this is the case. Now imagine someone who is sent out to clean in their own - the job is ten times harder even if they are doing a deep cleaning for a 1 bedroom apartment. Second, the rate of pay is abysmal and does not reflect the labour that goes into cleaning an apartment (especially if a cleaner is sent out on her own). I have had deep cleans on multiple occasions in the past and on all of them, two cleaners were sent out to do the job. My experience with Maid2Clean only tells me that they are money hungry greed filled lions who have no care for paying their workers decently for the labour they do. We live in a Britain that is quickly becoming scraps and the economy is dismal and things will only get worse. Families are suffering in the midst of it all, and compassion is needed now more than ever as everyday people struggle to feed their families / pay their bills / live life. As she worked 4 long hours deep cleaning, I paid my assigned cleaner above £14. To clients who wish to use cleaning services: Please think about the conditions of workers who perform intensive labour ie cleaners, and how the service they provide benefits you more than it does them in their industry. If you’re thinking of having cleaners come into your home, please consider what their base rate is and determine whether it is fair or unfair. It’s all about compassion for your fellow man.

title: A bit disappointed to be honest
review: A bit disappointed to be honest.  I paid for a weekly 2 hour clean of just kitchen and bathroom.  As it’s just a one person household and I am a pretty clean person plus the bathroom is small that should be more than adequate.  The cleaner overall was pleasant and did a reasonably good general clean but I had to ask that the shower glass needed cleaning and also that the shower plug hole could be lifted and cleaned to remove hair and soap scum etc.  This was not well received even though it was asked in a nice manner for something I assumed would be done.  I then asked for an extra hour and asked if it would be possible for the oven to be cleaned and I would provide a box cleaner which was easy to use and the cleaner agreed they could do this and it would be fairly easy to do with the box cleaner.  On the day the cleaner finished and said the cooker was nice and clean but they hadn’t used the box cleaner provided but their own stuff (you are asked to provide your own cleaning products and I went out of my way to provide the preferred cleaners that they liked to use).   The oven was still dirty with splatters on the glass and the racks were dirty too.  I wouldnt have minded so much if I had been told that they didnt want to use the box cleaner at the start and their alternative cleaner had cleaned the oven properly.   I paid the cleaners charge as I didnt want an argument on the day but then contacted M2C to ask for a refund of the fees for the extra hour and a different cleaner.  Initially I was told they’d look into it then I was told Id get a refund but was not refunded straight away then i just received a refund of a portion of the agency fee.  I emailed again and I was told that because cleaner wouldnt give back the money for the hour I was stuck with it and money couldnt be refunded.  A further email and call and I am now getting a refund through my agency fee hopefully that happens.  Its a shame its taken such a long process to get a refund e.g. emails and calls.  I wanted a replacement cleaner but they couldnt find me one at first as I wanted one to replace the same time and day as I have and when one was found they now not coming as they have transport issues.  So now I have to wait to get another cleaner.  I always try to be reasonable and understand that things happen and Ive thought seriously before writing this but certainly for my region of the country customer services arent great I hope my new cleaner, when I get one, is good as I can see a lot of people do get good cleaners and are happy and thats all I wanted.  I would like to add that they have said they will refund via my agency fee and have apologised for the problems i have had so at least that is fair.NEW EDIT TO REVIEWAfter speaking to Amanda from M2C today 11/11/23 she gets 5 stars from me for customer service.  Was understanding, helpful and went above and beyond to help me out.  She has put right all my issues and hopefully i will get a new cleaner soon.

review: Cameron did an amazing job fitting my boiler. Was friendly and polite, went and collected my boiler himself when the delivery was delayed. Helped me set up my Hive and returned at another date to complete my Flush when it couldn't be completed during fitting.During the fitting he needed to create a hole in my all and redo the piping to be able to fit my boiler. He explained all this to me and communicated it clearly so this is fine. He also confirmed that someone would resolve the damage after the fitting was complete.The problem comes after this. No one has contacted me about fixing the hole in my wall. The only contact I have at 0800repair is Cameron and he isn't a builder, and it's not his job to source one.I have contacted British Gas 3 times as they are who I actually have a contract with. The third time they had me wait as they spoke to area manager for 0800repair and told me that this manager would get back to me by the end of the day. It's now 11pm.I understand that it may difficult to source a builder, but you need to communicate these things to your customers. I've been left staring at a hole in my wall for over a week and no one from 0800repair thought to contact me to reassure me that they intend to repair the damage. It's very disappointing as the experience through Cameron was great.

So we made allowance and expected it to arrive within 2 weeks assuming the time scale was working days. However i was subsequantly provided a dispatch date of the 8th April which is 16 working days. On the 8th i was notified that the manufacturer had dispatch and it was expected on the 9th. Arranged for someone to wait in all day and the plumber to arrive the following as the leaking tank has corroded and needed several repairs to stem the leak.  No delivery received so i called Plumb Nation cusotmer services 10th and Kirsty confirmed the dispatch and delviery date. She informed me she woudl find out what was happening and get back to me. Nothng that day and on Thursday the 8th i recieved a short email confirming my enquiry and they woudl respond within 48hrs. No call received by late morning on the 9th so i called customer services again. This time i am told that Custoemr Services can not call the manufacturer as they have another department who does that and that department called Gledhill yesterday but had not had a response ( i have to question call or Emailed?) i was told that there was nothing further they can do and awaiting to find out if Gledhill have dispatched or even manufactured the tank. I haev asked for a response by the end of the day but like a good politican Cusotmer Service continued to reply that they would get back to me when they get a response themselves from Gledhill. Clearly Plumbnation have poor processes for dealing with enquiries and in the arrangement of drop shipping products. I wonder howmuch the Senior Management and Shareholders know of this and how it will affect future businesses as the Highbourne group own several other Plumbing Sales businesses.  Perhaps i will try a CEO to CEO call with David Evans. I have used Plumbnation previsouly with no issue and wihile issues do occur the way thsi has been handled is highly dissappointing, i am now unlikely to use them again and would receommed other to consider alternatives. I must point out that Kirsty was pleasant and apologetic, not so the gentleman i spoke with today. If he work for my company he would be recieving further training!

Kingston Preservation provide damp proofing and timber treatments for dry & wet rot eradication to residential & commercial customers throughout Edinburgh, East Lothian, West Lothian, Midlothian, Fife and the Scottish Borders. In addition, we are specialists in the conversion of damp under-pavement cellars in Edinburgh’s New Town into dry usable spaces.

Damp Proofing & Timber Treatment in Edinburgh
For over 25 years, we have been undertaking all aspects of damp and timber treatments, for a wide range of clients in the Edinburgh region. Our damp proofing, dry & wet rot timber treatments and mould removal are all guaranteed for 30 years. Free surveys of property requiring treatment.

Cellar Conversions in Edinburgh’s New Town
We have developed our own processes for converting damp under-pavement vaulted cellars in Edinburgh’s New Town into dry and useful spaces that can be used for a variety of purposes, such as storage, utility rooms and offices. Perfect if you are looking to increase space in your property.
title: Terrible - unusable cellars
review: I had 2 cellars converted by Stuart in 2021, one into a gym and one into an office. In under a year there was green and black mould growing in both. Stuart returned and added some vents which made no difference. They are now overgrown with mould, the electrics have blown as a result, the spaces are unusable with the roofs ready to collapse and the furniture in there ruined. I’ve made numerous attempts to contact Stuart to either have them re done or receive a refund under the 10yr “guarantee”. He usually turns up and tells me they’ll sort it but this has now been going on for over a year. Please don’t use this company.

title: What you get is not what you see
review: I was quite happy with my first purchase last year. But a recent purchase not quite. I bought stair nosing and planks for my staircase. The product "Natural Horizontal Bamboo 15mm Stair Nosing"M1007C is quite well made, with great finish, texture, and color. However it is not matched in terms of color and texture with "Natural Horizontal Bamboo Flooring (F1005)" though it is described on their website as a match. Out of 12 stair nosings, only one matches! The problem is that F1005 is not so great: plainly with almost no texture or very pale, color is lighter than M1007C. My staircase is now finished but it does not look good, it has two distinct color stripes one for the nosing and the other the rest of the tread. I acknowledge that color and texture of solid wood change from plank to plank, however from my experience this is not due to natural factor, but poorly produced. Furthermore, M1007C is poorly cut, many edges are off the right angle a few degrees; so do not suppose both edges are perfectly right angle if you intend to buy it for your project.

When I pointed out again it was your quote you told me the guy who made these calculations wasn’t in the office and he would ring the next morning.  I kept my phone on me all day yesterday and no call back. I should not be taking time out in chasing you again and again for some closure on this. You over quoted by 6 sqm and you should take it back free delivery charge and pay me the full refund. I look forward to your favourable reply. Regards

description: Supply of bamboo flooring and accessories.
title: Disappointing longevity
review: Always had helpful customer service but product quality is not great. We have the pebbled colour bamboo flooring which is treated to get the colour and is easily marked. Had I known this, I would never have purchased as we have young children and the area gets a lot of foot traffic. When some of the planks first turned up they were already marked and I didn't bother to complain as thought it would just be these small few planks which could be used in areas that would be hidden by sofas etc. Unfortunately the wood has cracked on the joints where I have my dining room chairs  and the thresholds received arrived with white marks on which is disappointing as the product isn't cheap. My partner argued to buy laminate and I insisted on bamboo flooring and now with the state of the floor after just 2years I wish we had used laminate too as it would have lasted longer! It looks nice but the finish scratches easily and just isn't as hardy as it should be.

Accidentally ordered too little, so ended up going back a few times, but wouldn’t hesitate to go again for other tiles. Quality of the tile were great too. My tiler was impressed. Thank you for a fab exchange.

This meant we had the tiles we wanted in time for the tiler to lay.  Had it not been for Tiles-direct.com and Isha I would most likely have had to go for another type of tile, and that would have annoyed me forever.  Also, just to say, I called twice and my call was successfully answered and dealt with twice.  As I say, perhaps I got lucky, but in my experience Tiles-direct.com were pretty good.  The only reason I have marked down 1 star is because the print on the tile looks a little inferior to the same tile offered by Topps Tiles.  Then again, Tiles-direct.com were much cheaper, so the price reflects this and I guess bumping them down a star is a tad unfair.  Anyway, I thought I would just to convey the quality point. title: Great customer service - poor quality tiles
review: We ordered 46 large format (600x1200) "pure white" tiles.  They arrived as promised within a few days but were stacked vertically on a pallet which was too small for the lifting truck to get off the lorry without damaging it.  The tiles had toppled over during the journey due to the poor packaging and we had to assist manhandling the tiles on to a pallet we had.  We found 9 tiles were broken or chipped.  When I checked all the tiles a further 15 tiles had manufacturing faults so only 18 of the 42 tiles were useable.Tile Direct agreed to send a new batch and collect the bulk of the damaged or faulty tiles but the next batch were no better and I had to reject them and ask for a full refund.Given the quality problems, this would have been a 1 star review and the only reason for the 3 stars is that throughout the process, and whilst it was time consuming,  annoying and caused delay,  Tile Direct's customer service team were excellent.  They answered the phone, listened to the problem and actioned replacements, collections and refunds exactly as they said they would and within a reasonable time frame.  Whilst the situation was not great and the tiles were awful quality, the customer service team were excellent and far better than many others we have contacted in recent months.

We also added some pretty border tiles to the order. They arrived when they should, but me being heavily pregnant and husband away with work - it took us 3 days to move the tiles to open them safely, which were heavily bubble wrapped. 5 had broken corners. And our border tiles weren't there. No information on these, as in whether they were out of stock, or on their way, or just missed.I contacted Tiles direct on the Friday, and fair play on Sunday they responded. Explained the x2 day to complain about breakages (we contacted them on day 3). Ultimately we figured we could probably use the broken tiles anyway for the smaller gaps, so weren't too bothered (although question the legality of this policy?!), but confirmed I was concerned that 50% of the cost of our order hadn't been fulfilled. TD responded to advise they were out of stock, and would I like a refund!Replied advising that I definitely would like a refund if we weren't getting what we paid for! They confirmed this would be processed. In the meantime we ordered more border tiles from elsewhere (B&Q for safety!). Next thing we know, the border tiles get delivered from TD!! What?!By this point I've absolutely lost the will. Haven't had the refund, got tiles we don't want but we decided to keep them for another project eventually. 3 Stars because we did get our order, and we did get responses from TD but I definitely wouldn't use again or recommend anyone goes near them. Some lovely tiles on their website though. A shame!

title: Overall a good service with friendly and thorough cleaners.
review: Overall, a very good service.  However, it could be made clearer when booking that a deep clean does NOT cover removal of cupboard/drawer contents, then cleaning of said cupboards/drawers inside and the putting back the contents tidily, which is frustrating, as that would be my definition of a deep clean. In addition, also in my definition of a deep clean, any occasional items, such as lamps, pictures, bowls etc that are on surfaces in living/bedrooms will NOT get moved to dust/clean underneath unless you make it clear at the outset when you meet the cleaner. In my case the latter was requested and done well. Finally, I wish that they would publish their office contact number after a clean has been paid for, as I was unable to speak to anyone to clarify the above until I emailed a request to be called back, when the clean had already begun! However, the lady did call to tell me that the ladies were running late and they were thorough, and friendly.

We finally found Olanrewanju and he was great!

title: A former cleaner's review
review: All the reviews are from the perspective of the customers who book housekeep and their experiences are reflected in their reviews. However, some of these reviews are based on experiences that should not have happened. Customer expectations are often misaligned with what the service provides. By that I mean, the customers should not have been able to make that booking. A classic example is when customers try to avoid paying a lot of money for a deep-clean or end of tenancy clean. So they book housekeep for 4-6 hours thinking that this amount of time can be used to deep clean a small house or flat. NO! Stop doing this! Half way through the clean, the housekeeper often realises the customer is expecting a very thorough clean for which we do not have the materials. Customers book cleans for 2-3 hours but the ovens are caked with thick grease. That takes 24 hours overnight to be done properly. I did have two lovely customers around the Putney area and an amazing customer in Tooting. What made me quit were two things. I had some personal stuff going on. But even after that, I didn't want to go back because of some very unfair bad feedback I got from a couple in the Battersea Park area. After that, I completely lost interest. The company itself are OK. The app never had problems, the support team were good, frequent pay is good, bonus is a good idea too. Cleaners should be paid more for their own products. review: I have generally found the process of booking cleaners, and for the most part the quality of the cleans received, to be good. However I find the app a bit clunky at times and not intuitive. For example, not clear how to send a message, was unclear when I had changed to a different cleaner, as this was not clearly indicated...With some tweaks to the app, process could be much smoother. Also I have several times posted feedback on cleaners but received no acknowledgement that my comments were ever posted.

title: Lost a customer
review: I have felt constrained by the restrictions on the number of cleans I can skip. Customers should have the option to skip a clean whenever they want, as long as it's done before 24 hours to give the cleaner ample time to adjust their schedule.Also Dherk cabading When customers request a cancellation, please refrain from sending a strange email and not canceling my cleaner. This has resulted in the company losing a customer!

title: So far I'm not impressed
review: So far I'm not impressed. The set up process was smooth. The app works well with the option to add instructions. However, this may have raised the expectations as the cleaning itself was disappointing. Housekeep responded immediately and will match us with a new cleaner. I was here for the clean so I know that cleaning took place. However, none of the surfaces are actually clean now. The instructions clearly weren't read. title: A Disappointing Experience with Housekeep

Instead, they offered a free re-clean, a policy that wasn’t mentioned in their terms and conditions or during the booking process. It's clear that Housekeep prioritises offering re-cleans over customer satisfaction and financial compensation. I strongly advise considering alternative cleaning services.

title: Not for the time poor
review: Based on previous reviews I was a little anxious about using this handyman service, but I'd struggled to actually contact a independent handyman direct, I was finding I was leaving a lot of voicemails/sending a lot of emails and getting no response. The major benefit I found with 0800 handyman was being able to go and speak to someone face to face, explain the job and get a time/cost estimate. On the day of the job, it got to 9:15am and there was no sign of the handyman I had been told to expect at 9. I rang the office and they said he had bailed and wouldn't be coming. Not the best start. Another handyman was located fairly promptly and he arrived at 10:15.I am pleased with the quality of the majority of work carried out, particularly fitting a new lock mechanism into the bedroom door. The exception being a shelf in the bathroom cabinet which needed tightening. He asked if I would need to be able to move it in the future, and I said no, so I assumed he would be gluing it. Fine. He used some kind of clear filler which has not set solidly (24 hours later), I could have done a better job with a tube of super glue.  I was also a little surprised when it took 5 hours instead of the estimated 3, and when his mate turned up to help him "get the job done quicker". This just meant I paid for two people instead of one.In summary, if you are time poor then I would probably avoid. I was able to be flexible, and as a result the job was carried out quickly, cleanly and to a standard I am pleased with (for the most part).

I was not happy with the overall tally of charges.Despite rain being a visitor, and the handyman therefore being unable to complete the job, he spent an additional two extra hours at the property. I would like to point out that he told me he would not charge me for an additional hour to the half day rate which I booked him for. In fact he ended up charging me for two.Although he was absolutely pleasant of demeanour, I am still struggling, very much indeed, to work out just why it took him so long to undertake such basic, basic work.The company refused to clarify why they quoted me for a half day rate for a job that, even unfinished, ended up taking a two further hours.I booked their services because of the appearance of fixed prices – no hidden charges. title: Absolutely terrible company
review: Absolutely terrible company, they have got to be the worst example of a "none communicating" business that in my 40 years in the social housing sector I have ever had the displeasure of doing business with.Order placed: company was brilliant, rapid response,then, 3 packs of flooring arrived cling film wrapped damaged stock, 2 packs where eventually replaced after initially being informed that they would be delivered in 2 days, a day later an email arrived stating no stock and a 6 week wait?After several complaints and citing that we where now left with a safeguarding issue for our 3 yr old foster daughter ( unfinished flooring /trip / toe stub hazard) we where then told that 2 packs where taken from another customers order? And would be delivered two days later, we stayed home all day, no delivery, zero contact from UKFD my wife then phoned to have an unbelievable response of " as it's a discontinued product"?? Then our dispatcher cancelled the order, so when did you intend to let us know we weren't getting a delivery.We where then told a courier would deliver the following Monday, again stayed home all day,no delivery, I phoned the courier who's response was, oh our driver was too busy ,you should get it tomorrow? Again zero communication from the courier.We raised a complaint with UKFD, with an absolute brilliant reply of "we" shouldn't book installers for the delivery days? Good job we didn't for 3 days waiting for confirmed/ none deliveries. (Who would compensate the installers)After another complaint requesting compensating for 3 days waiting for ( none deliveries) the best ever joke of a reply was" you shouldn't stay home waiting in case there's delays" too right there was 3 ## days.We where then sent £40 delivery credit ( not as UKFD) say was compensation.My job as a surveyor lost time of 3 days would be more than the cost of the flooring.2 months later one board has delaminated, I have sent photos, answered a questionnaire, 4 weeks later and numerous emails requesting a replacement 1m/2 to uplift and replace the 1 x plank, the usual zero response, and just ignore the customer My main issue is that UKFD delivered "faulty,substandard goods", but more concerning breaching the sale of goods actually by not stating that what we purchased in good faith was actually a discontinued product, if we had been made aware of this then we would not of purchased the product, we have emailed UKFD numerous times, with their "ignore them and they'll go away" attitude -- customer service does not exist,,,unless you're actually buying from them.Purchase at your peril.I have since noticed quite a few negative reviews with identical issues of faulty goods being delivered, then totally ignored once you complain.All I can say to those with 5 star reviews " you are the lucky ones"Read some of the 1 star ratings of this horrendous company

title: A very expensive mistake
review: I had a new bathroom installed last year and we had water coming through which left a large stain on the kitchen ceiling. I called this company ( website: Glasgow Plumbing Services) around 10am on a Tuesday (not evening, night time or weekend) and was asked to pay £147 up front for a plumber to visit, despite their website stating 'no call out charge'. I was assured the price was to guarantee a plumber that same day and for them to undertake diagnostic work and perform any fix that could be done within the hour I had paid for. He arrived at 5pm and only had a mobile phone with cracked screen for a camera and torch to explore under the shower tray. He was here for an hour but couldn't identify the leak. The next day I recieved an expensive quote of several hundred pounds for work needed to identify the leak (trace and access). I called another plumber via a Nextdoor app recommendation the next day who arrived within 3 hours and brought an endoscope (worth £70) and a high powered torch, which allowed him to identify the leak and fix it with re-sealing, the total cost was £120. Sad to say contacting this company originally feels like a very expensive mistake. I have likely saved myself hundreds of pounds and a lot of hassle by contacting a different plumber to take on the job. I do hope this company act on this feedback by reviewing their overly expensive pricing, their upfront payment policy and the poor equipment they send their plumbers out with, all of which felt unsatisfactory. It's important to highlight that the plumber they sent was professional, friendly and tried his best with the 'diagnostic' equipment he had. The office staff were also very friendly and professional when dealing with my calls. That's why this review is 2 stars and not 1.
